Name: (AT)Candy Valley Farm Buildings for Winter Style
Author: Kyuya258369
Description:
[size=5]                                                [b][color=#ff0000]All my mods just upload to NEXUS.
                                              Please don't re-upload anywhere else
[/color][/b][/size][b][color=#ff0000]                                               [/color][/b][size=5][b][color=#ff0000]我的所有mod只上传在N网，请不要二次上传到其他任何地方。[/color][/b]

[/size][size=3]Candy Valley Farm Buildings for Winter Style with no seasonal.
没有季节变化的冬季风格糖果谷农场建筑。

[color=#f4f4f4]This is a WIP module that has only completed winter textures, and I use them for every season. After all the work on this module is completed, I will release the complete seasonal module. Before that, the remaining three seasons will be uploaded in advance in this form.
这是一个只完成了冬季纹理的半成品模组，我将它们用于每一个季节。当这个模组所有工作都完成后我就会发布季节性的完整模组，在这之前，剩下的三个季节都会以这样的形式提前上传。[/color][/size][color=#00ffff]

[/color][b][size=3][color=#ff7700]注意，这是一个AT模式的模组，关于AT模组的详细信息与使用方法请前去Alternative Textures模组页面查阅。
Note that this is an AT mode module. For detailed information and usage of AT modules, please refer to the Alternative Textures module page.[/color]
[/size][/b]
[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]要求/Need[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]SMAPI, AT, ContentPatcher[/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]安装/Install[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1.下载并安装好所有前置。
1.Download and install all required.[/size]
[size=3]
2.下载本文件然后解压。
2.Download the pack and unzip it.[/size]
[size=3]
3.将文件夹放入“Mods”中。
3.Put the folder in "Mods".

[color=#ff7700][b]NOTE：Because I removed the pointer from the golden clock, and errors may occur when using only AT when placing goods in the shipping bin, so I made corrections through CP. If you have used the texture of a golden clock or shipping bin, please open the configuration file for settings (true or false, default to false) or use GMCM (Nexus: 5098) to check in the game.
需要注意：因为黄金钟我删去了指针，出货箱在放入货物时，如果只使用AT纹理会出现错误，所以我通过CP进行了修正。如果你使用了黄金钟或者出货箱的纹理，请打开配置文件进行设置（true或false，默认为false）或者使用GMCM（Nexus：5098）在游戏中进行勾选。[/b][/color]
[/size][u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]
[/url][/u][color=#00ffff][size=4][b]重要/Important[/b][/size][/color][size=3]
1.你可以修改它以供你个人私下使用，但没有我的许可请不要再次上传。
1. You can edit this mod for your own use. But don't upload it anywhere again without my permission.[/size]
[size=3]
2.不要花钱去购买任何非作者授权发布的收费模组。
2. Please do not spend money on modules published by non authors for any reason.[/size]
